channel.title: The Safer Click
channel.description: Calm, source-first guides that help ordinary people spot scams, secure accounts, and make safer choices online.

item.title: Your Bank Is Calling About Fraud. Hang Up Anyway.
item.description: What to do when someone claiming to be your bank calls about fraud: hang up, verify through a trusted channel, and never move money to protect it.

item.title: The 10-Minute Account Safety Reset
item.description: A prioritized ten-minute account security checklist covering email, passkeys or MFA, recovery details, sessions, and software updates.

item.title: Passkeys, in Plain English: What Changes When You Turn One On
item.description: A practical explanation of passkeys, why they resist phishing, where they are stored, and what to check before enabling one.
